anm_er.name: anm_er

promotion.rule: a test is promoted to supported when, against each of its references, (1) the mean over every paired dataset of D = SHD(Andrey) - SHD(reference) is at most 0 and (2) no cell (search, data, d, n) has its percentile bootstrap 95% interval of the mean D entirely above 0 (10,000 resamples); pairs are datasets both finished, a timeout is coverage; the paired t interval is reported beside
